error_message:
ERROR MESSAGE:
"[SCTP]   Received SCTP SHUTDOWN EVENT"

Context:
This SCTP shutdown event indicates that the SCTP association was closed unexpectedly, which would disrupt the communication between the CU and DU or between network functions. Following this, the log shows removal of the SCTP endpoint and releasing the DU ID on assoc_id 337, indicating loss of connectivity. This event is critical as it prevents ongoing UE context management and data transfer, effectively causing a connection failure in the F1 interface.
